# Pin how the currency field parses and renders amounts

## Welcome 👋

`Neo.form.field.Currency` is Neo's number field for money: type `12.345` and it keeps `12.35`; store a `5` and it shows `5.00`. Two small methods do all of that work, and no test pins them yet. Your spec becomes the record of what the field promises.

This is a **good first issue** for Hacktoberfest 2026. It needs Node.js and a clone of this repository: no Docker, no AI setup, no framework internals beyond one file.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Reserved for first-time Neo.mjs contributors.** The maintainer team will not claim, edit, or implement this issue through **2026-10-31**. Comment here to claim it, and ask anything on this issue.

**Set up once:** follow [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone), including `npm run bundle-browser-deps`: without it the unit suite selects zero tests.

## Where things live

- Source: `src/form/field/Currency.mjs`: `inputValueAdjustor(value)` turns typed text into a number, `inputValueRenderer(value)` turns a number into the text you see.
- New test file: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/Currency.spec.mjs`
- Pattern to copy: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/EmailValidate.spec.mjs` (the `setup()` call and imports at the top)
- Tip: the currency field, like every number field, needs one main-thread stub while your tests run. Install it in `test.beforeAll`, only if it is missing, and remove it in `test.afterAll`, exactly as `test/playwright/unit/apps/colors/ViewportController.spec.mjs` does in its `test.beforeAll`: `const main = Neo.ns('Neo.main', true); if (!main.DomEvents) { main.DomEvents = {registerDisabledInputChars() {}, unregisterDisabledInputChars() {}}; /* delete it again in afterAll */ }`. Do not put it at the top of the file: another spec imports the real `DomEvents`, and `npm run test-unit` then stops with `Namespace collision in unitTestMode for Neo.main.DomEvents`.

## What to cover

`inputValueAdjustor(value)`:

| Input | Returns today |
|---|---|
| `''` | `null` |
| `'12'` | `12` |
| `'12.345'` | `12.35` |
| `'-5.5'` | `-5.5` |
| `'1e3'` | `1000` |
| `3.5` (already a number) | `3.5`, unchanged |
| `'1.005'` | `1`: the binary float for 1.005 sits just below it, so `toFixed(2)` gives `'1.00'` |
| `'abc'` | `NaN` |

`inputValueRenderer(value)`:

| Input | Returns today |
|---|---|
| `null` | `null` |
| `5` | `'5.00'` |
| `1.5` | `'1.50'` |
| `0.125` | `'0.13'` |

The field also sets `maxValue: 1000000` and `stepSize: 0.01`.

## Done when

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/form/field/Currency.spec.mjs` exists, following the pattern file's setup.
- [ ] One `test(...)` per table row, plus one for the two config values.
- [ ] Test-only. If you think a row is wrong (`'abc'` giving `NaN` rather than `null`, say), write it on this issue before changing `src/`: that is a behaviour change for its own PR.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/form/field/Currency.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` passes.

## Out of scope

Changing the field's behaviour, currency symbols or locales, and the base `Number` field.

## While you wait for review

You just pinned one small piece of a multi-threaded application engine: in Neo.mjs your app's code runs inside a web worker, and the main thread only paints. Two things worth ten minutes:

- **See the part nobody expects.** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `npm run server-start`, open `apps/workstation/`, and drag a tab out of the browser window. It becomes its own OS window, still running, with the same component instances and the same worker. [Benefits: Introduction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md) explains why that is possible.
- **Your coding agent can go much further here.** The skills this repository's AI maintainers work with are published on npm as [`neo-agent-skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neo-agent-skills), and they need no Knowledge Base and no Memory Core. With Claude or GPT beside you, the `help wanted` issues are within reach after this one.
